brief:
CNN reported that White House special envoy Jared Kushner simultaneously managed ceasefire negotiations for the Gaza conflict while supporting the war through a private company connected to Israeli military operations. The American network said Kushner conducted talks aimed at ending the war on one front while his business interests advanced it on another.

Kushner held the dual role of peace negotiator and financial stakeholder in Israeli military activity, according to CNN's findings.
dek: CNN reported that White House special envoy Jared Kushner simultaneously managed ceasefire negotiations for the Gaza conflict while supporting the war through a private company connected to Israeli military operations.
title: CNN investigation says Kushner negotiated Gaza ceasefire while funding Israeli war
